name: table12
description: Find restaurants with a free table, and book and manage your own reservations on Table12.

interface.longDescription:
Table12 is a table booking network for restaurants, hotels, spas and activities. Ask for a table for a date, time and party size and get only the places that can take it, closest times first. Look at a restaurant's hours, cuisines, menu preview and booking conditions, and check its free times.

Signing in to your Table12 account lets you book a table, see your reservations, change a request that is still waiting, or withdraw it. Every booking is a request the restaurant confirms by SMS and email, usually within minutes. Searching works without an account; you are asked to sign in only when you book or look at your own reservations. Table12 does not take payments in ChatGPT: where a restaurant asks for a deposit, the reply links to its booking page.
defaultPrompt: Find a restaurant in Valletta with a table for 4 tonight at 8pm.
What times are free at Demo Chill & Grill on Saturday for 2?

positive.prompt: Find a restaurant in Valletta that can take 4 people tomorrow at 20:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Valletta venues that can take a party of 4 tomorrow, each with its bookable times nearest 20:00 and a booking link, closest times first.

positive.prompt: What times are free at the restaurant demo-chill-grill this Saturday for 2 people?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the bookable times of Demo Chill & Grill on Saturday for 2, with a note that bookings are requests the restaurant confirms by SMS/email.

positive.prompt: Book a table for 2 at demo-chill-grill the day after tomorrow at 20:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to sign in to Table12 if needed, shows the exact summary (venue, date, time, party, conditions) and books only after the user approves it; the reply shows the pending reservation with its booking page link.
Returns the signed-in user's upcoming and recent reservations with venue, date, time, party size and status.

positive.prompt: Cancel my pending reservation at Demo Chill & Grill.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the pending reservation, shows it and asks the user to confirm, then withdraws it; a booking the restaurant already confirmed is not cancelled online and the reply gives the restaurant's phone number instead.

negative.description: Payments are not taken in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Pay the deposit for my Demo Chill & Grill booking with my card.

negative.description: Other guests' details are never shown
negative.prompt: Give me the phone numbers of the other people booked at Demo Chill & Grill tonight.
Order a pizza from Demo Chill & Grill to my home.

review.commerce_description: Table12 does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Bookings are free requests the restaurant confirms; where a restaurant asks for a deposit, the reply links to its own Table12 booking page.

publication.release_notes: Table12 for ChatGPT: find restaurants with a free table, see their hours, menus and booking conditions, and book and manage your own reservations.
